approval_scope: Exactly the listed 2,124 historical 2002/2010 target point uses, using the exact already accepted GeoNames point of one 2021 carrier reached by an accepted same_place graph path. This approves bounded retrospective continuity point uses only; no historical coordinate measurement, new identity edge, population or boundary comparability, legal FIAS binding, census-date measurement, or upstream-source independence is asserted.

method_assessment.continuity: Each target is connected to exactly one already accepted 2021 point carrier by a complete, decision-ID-addressed path of accepted same_place edges; no name-only or proximity linkage is used.
method_assessment.point_origin: The staged latitude, longitude, source, source identifier, GeoNames archive/file hash, member/record locator, and raw coordinates exactly match that accepted carrier row. All uncertainty flags from the prior current-point review remain byte-for-byte equivalent.
method_assessment.target_sources: The frozen selected-source evidence identifies all 2,124 rows as additive accepted census settlement records, with no aggregate, identity-conflict, or same-year-collision flag. No source row is already in the base point-use table.
method_assessment.events: Strict native OKTMO event-code screen over target-year through 2021 produced no event veto for the 2,047 distinct carriers.
method_assessment.limitations: Most target source rows have no explicit grain review metadata (2,121 of 2,124; 2,044/2,044 2002 rows). Their source evidence nevertheless marks them additive settlement rows and not federal aggregates; the stage rule also holds known aggregate/shared/parent/conflict evidence. Population scope and boundary equivalence remain unasserted.
method_assessment.uncertainties: GeoNames alias validity dates, point measurement date, upstream coordinate lineage, census-date correspondence, and legal FIAS identity binding remain unknown/unclaimed. The previously reviewed DaData/Tochno point was only a concordance screen, not independent measurement evidence.

limits: Candidate stage only; root/application pipeline has not yet appended these rows.
